layout: Eleven individual transparent pose images matching ashen-stray-front, ashen-brood-front and mire-guardian-front; CSS supplies movement. The bite filename contains the lunging claw/bite attack.

prompts.prompt: Create a NEW SCHWARZE KLUFT / BLACK RIFT battle arena background for dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn. Attached arena is STYLE, CAMERA PERSPECTIVE and framing reference only. Match polished painterly semi-realistic game art and very wide panoramic approximately 2.46:1 (1967x800). New setting: enormous subterranean black basalt canyon, towering jagged cavern walls and broken stone pillars framing both sides, immense misty abyss in middle distance, distant natural rock bridge and receding silhouettes deep below. A cold narrow shaft of pale light filters through a high fissure; subtle violet spectral glows in distant cracks and a few amethyst seams in edge rocks. Foreground/lower 55 percent MUST be a broad EMPTY FLAT solid dark-gray rock platform for three enemies, continuous walkable arena from bottom edge to middle distance, no central hole. Cliff drop-offs only beyond sides and behind arena. Detailed rock foreground corners frame the center, horizon/ledge line near 45 percent height. Dark eerie atmosphere but enough soft cool gray illumination to read floor and monster silhouettes. No orange lava/fire, trees, marsh, buildings, people, monsters, text, UI or border. Fill whole panorama.

Create a NEW monster species KLUFTWANDLER / RIFT STALKER for dark fantasy RPG DarkReturn. Attached creature is ONLY a reference for detailed polished semi-realistic rendering, FRONT CAMERA and full-body sprite presentation, NOT creature design. New silhouette: lean hunched BIPEDAL abyss predator with TWO digitigrade legs and TWO elongated arms, narrow ribbed torso, sleek angular obsidian-black organic CHITIN rather than stone armor, blade-edged forearms ending in long three-fingered hooked claws. Narrow alien skull with three small backward swept crown spines (not ram horns), FOUR small violet glowing eyes arranged two pairs, serrated fanged mouth, three backward pointed spines on each shoulder, thin violet luminous seams between rib plates. Ash-gray edges and soft cool rimlight keep dark creature highly readable. No wood, moss, fur, lava or orange light, no humanoid clothes or weapons. IDLE stance front-facing square to viewer, slightly crouched and ready to spring, feet planted wide, long arms held low and outward, mouth partly open. Same neutral soft lighting and craftsmanship as reference. Square 1254x1254 canvas, entire creature inside central 84 percent width, crown near 7 percent height, lowest feet/claws near 94 percent, nothing cropped. No scenery, floor, text, detached effects, ground shadow or UI. Genuine transparent alpha background.

Edit attached KLUFTWANDLER / RIFT STALKER idle sprite into ATTACK animation frame. Preserve EXACT same lean bipedal obsidian-chitin alien, four violet eyes, crown/shoulder spines, ribbed narrow torso and violet seams. Same detailed rendering, square canvas and FRONT camera. Attack pose: predator lunges low toward viewer, fanged jaw wide open, BOTH blade-edged arms reach forward with hooked claws spread, legs crouched and braced. Keep complete claws, shoulder spines, head and feet inside image with at least 6 percent transparent side margins. Do not enlarge body to crop fingers. Body scale broadly matches idle, feet near 94 percent baseline. Two arms and two legs only, no new anatomy. No weapons, blood, particles, floor, shadow plane, background, text or UI. Genuine transparent alpha.
